testimonials.text: The course was well-structured and organized. The presentation was very helpful and filled with concepts in concise manner.
The lecture video was informative and to the point. It taught me what the warning signs to look out for are.

The aspect of the course I found most interesting was learning how to properly assess and manage a burn injury based on its severity and extent. I found it especially helpful to learn about the different degrees of burns, initial first aid, wound care, fluid management and the importance of preventing infection.
The most interesting part is how to manage each degree of burn initially.
